package consumer

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"

	arc "github.com/cratis/arc.go"
	"github.com/cratis/arc.go/execution"
	"github.com/cratis/arc.go/identity"
	"github.com/cratis/arc.go/queries"
	di "github.com/cratis/fundamentals.go/dependencyinjection"
	"github.com/cratis/fundamentals.go/dependencyinjection/container"
)

func registry(t *testing.T, fail bool) (*container.Registry, *External) {
	t.Helper()
	r := &container.Registry{}
	external := &External{}
	if err := di.BindValue(r, external); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if fail {
		if err := di.Bind(r, di.Singleton, func(context.Context, di.Resolver) (*Dependency, error) { return nil, ConstructorError }); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	} else if err := di.BindValue(r, &Dependency{}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := RegisterServices(r); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return r, external
}
func closeProvider(t *testing.T, p di.Provider) {
	t.Helper()
	if err := p.Close(context.Background()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func TestGeneratedLifetimesAndOwnedFailure(t *testing.T) {
	Calls, ValueCalls, ValueCloses = 0, 0, 0
	r, external := registry(t, false)
	if Calls != 0 {
		t.Fatal("registration activated services")
	}
	p, err := r.Build()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer closeProvider(t, p)
	if Calls != 0 {
		t.Fatal("Build activated services")
	}
	a, err := p.NewScope(t.Context())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	b, err := p.NewScope(t.Context())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	foo, err := di.Resolve[IFoo](t.Context(), a)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	alias, err := di.Resolve[*FooAlias](t.Context(), a)
	if err != nil || foo != alias {
		t.Fatal("exact alias forwarding", err)
	}
	other, err := di.Resolve[IFoo](t.Context(), b)
	if err != nil || foo == other {
		t.Fatal("scoped reuse", err)
	}
	singleton, err := di.Resolve[ISingleton](t.Context(), a)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	same, err := di.Resolve[*Singleton](t.Context(), b)
	if err != nil || singleton != same {
		t.Fatal("singleton forwarding", err)
	}
	pair, err := di.Resolve[Pair](t.Context(), a)
	if err != nil || pair.First == pair.Second {
		t.Fatal("repeated transient argument coalesced", err)
	}
	triple, err := di.Resolve[Triple](t.Context(), a)
	if err != nil || triple.Ticks[0] == triple.Ticks[1] {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	quad, err := di.Resolve[Quad](t.Context(), a)
	if err != nil || quad.Ticks[0] == quad.Ticks[3] {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	wide, err := di.Resolve[*Wide](t.Context(), a)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	seen := map[*Tick]bool{}
	for _, tick := range wide.Ticks {
		if seen[tick] {
			t.Fatal("ordered wide arguments merged")
		}
		seen[tick] = true
	}
	forwarded, err := di.Resolve[ITick](t.Context(), a)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	second, err := di.Resolve[ITick](t.Context(), a)
	if err != nil || forwarded == second {
		t.Fatal("transient forwarding cached", err)
	}
	if _, err := di.Resolve[*Failure](t.Context(), a); !errors.Is(err, ConstructorError) || LastFailure.Closes != 1 {
		t.Fatal("failed result lost ownership", err)
	}
	if _, err := di.Resolve[Value](t.Context(), a); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := a.Close(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if alias.Closes != 1 || same.Closes != 0 || forwarded.(*Tick).Closes != 1 || ValueCloses != 1 {
		t.Fatal("scope close/borrowed forwarding differs")
	}
	for _, tick := range wide.Ticks {
		if tick.Closes != 1 {
			t.Fatal("wide result dependency not closed once")
		}
	}
	if err := b.Close(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	closeProvider(t, p)
	if same.Closes != 1 || external.Closes != 0 || alias.Closes != 1 {
		t.Fatal("singleton/external borrowed disposal differs")
	}
}
func TestGeneratedDisposableValueErrorPreservesRealResult(t *testing.T) {
	ValueCalls, ValueCloses = 0, 0
	var r container.Registry
	if err := di.BindValue(&r, &Dependency{Err: ConstructorError}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := di.BindValue(&r, &External{}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := RegisterServices(&r); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	p, err := r.Build()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer closeProvider(t, p)
	scope, err := p.NewScope(t.Context())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := di.Resolve[Value](t.Context(), scope); !errors.Is(err, ConstructorError) || ValueCalls != 1 || ValueCloses != 1 {
		t.Fatal("real failed disposable value lost ownership", err)
	}
	if err := scope.Close(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if ValueCloses != 1 {
		t.Fatal("failed value disposed twice")
	}
}

func TestGeneratedDependencyFailureHasNoDisposableZero(t *testing.T) {
	ValueCalls, ValueCloses = 0, 0
	r, _ := registry(t, true)
	p, err := r.Build()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer closeProvider(t, p)
	scope, err := p.NewScope(t.Context())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := di.Resolve[Value](t.Context(), scope); !errors.Is(err, ConstructorError) {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := scope.Close(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if ValueCalls != 0 || ValueCloses != 0 {
		t.Fatal("nonexistent disposable result constructed/disposed")
	}
}

type failingRegistrar struct {
	calls int
	err   error
}

func (r *failingRegistrar) Register(di.Binding) error {
	r.calls++
	if r.calls == 2 {
		return r.err
	}
	return nil
}
func TestGeneratedStrictDuplicatesAndPartialRegistrarFailure(t *testing.T) {
	r, _ := registry(t, false)
	if err := RegisterServices(r); !errors.Is(err, di.ErrDuplicate) {
		t.Fatal("duplicates silently skipped", err)
	}
	missing := &container.Registry{}
	if err := RegisterServices(missing); !errors.Is(err, di.ErrMissing) {
		t.Fatal("Existing presence not preflighted", err)
	}
	if missing.Contains(di.KeyFor[*Foo]()) {
		t.Fatal("missing Existing wrote partial registration")
	}
	failure := errors.New("registrar failure")
	fake := &failingRegistrar{err: failure}
	if err := RegisterServices(fake); !errors.Is(err, failure) || fake.calls != 2 {
		t.Fatal("partial registrar failure swallowed/continued", err)
	}
	if err := RegisterServices(nil); !errors.Is(err, di.ErrInvalidRegistration) {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func TestGeneratedArcStageLocalAndManualBorrowedCallbacks(t *testing.T) {
	for _, useContainer := range []bool{false, true} {
		t.Run(map[bool]string{false: "manual callbacks", true: "generated services"}[useContainer], func(t *testing.T) {
			Calls = 0
			resolutions := 0
			borrowed := &Foo{}
			options := arc.Options{}
			var supplied []ArcBindings
			var p di.Provider
			if useContainer {
				r, _ := registry(t, false)
				var err error
				p, err = r.Build()
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				defer closeProvider(t, p)
				options.ScopeFactory = p
			} else {
				supplied = []ArcBindings{{ResolveIFoo: func(context.Context, *execution.Scope) (IFoo, error) { resolutions++; return borrowed, nil }}}
			}
			builder, err := arc.NewBuilder(options)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if err := RegisterArtifacts(builder, supplied...); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			app, err := builder.Build()
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if Calls != 0 || resolutions != 0 {
				t.Fatal("eager generated activation")
			}
			if err := app.Start(t.Context()); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			for _, command := range []any{Denied{}, Add{}, Stop{}} {
				result, err := app.Commands().Execute(t.Context(), command)
				if err != nil || result.IsSuccess() || Calls != 0 || resolutions != 0 {
					t.Fatal("preactivation failure activated business factory", err)
				}
			}
			validated, err := app.Commands().Validate(t.Context(), Add{Name: "ok"})
			if err != nil || !validated.IsSuccess() || Calls != 0 || resolutions != 0 {
				t.Fatal("validate-only activated business factory", err)
			}
			denied, err := app.Queries().Perform(t.Context(), "Item.All", queries.RequestFor(queries.NoArguments{}, queries.Parameters{}))
			if err != nil || denied.IsSuccess() || Calls != 0 || resolutions != 0 {
				t.Fatal("query authorization activated factory", err)
			}
			request, err := queries.ReadGET(map[string][]string{"count": {"bad"}})
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			_, err = app.Queries().Perform(t.Context(), "Item.Find", request)
			if err == nil || Calls != 0 || resolutions != 0 {
				t.Fatal("query binding must fail before factory activation", err)
			}
			result, err := app.Commands().Execute(t.Context(), Add{Name: "ok"})
			value, present := result.Response()
			if err != nil || !result.IsSuccess() || !present || value != 5 {
				t.Fatal("Provide/Handle failed", err, result.Details())
			}
			query, err := app.Queries().Perform(identity.WithPrincipal(t.Context(), identity.System("Reader")), "Item.All", queries.RequestFor(queries.NoArguments{}, queries.Parameters{}))
			if err != nil || !query.IsSuccess() {
				t.Fatal("query failed", err, query.Details())
			}
			if (useContainer && Calls == 0) || (!useContainer && resolutions != 2) {
				t.Fatal("generated dependency inventory not called")
			}
			if err := app.Shutdown(t.Context()); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if borrowed.Closes != 0 {
				t.Fatal("borrowed callback value disposed")
			}
		})
	}
}
